title: Himminafl
content:
# Himminafl

Internal ID: AtgeirHimminAfl | Type: Polearm | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Crafting Materials: Refined eitr x45, Silver x15, Mandible x6 | Attack speed: 1.56 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 3.0 range, 360 angle, 1.0 height, 0.3 ray, no multitarget penalty | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Himminafl is the fourth polearm.

### Combat style

• Primary attack is a 3-stab combo with long reach and 2x damage on the last hit.
• Secondary attack does 1x damage and 6x staggering around the player, without the penalty to damage from multiple targets. It also triggers a lightning effect with randomly spawned lightning bolts

• stat: Black forge level | Quality 1: 1 | Quality 2: 2 | Quality 3: 3 | Quality 4: 4

## Notes

• The secondary attack is enough to stagger most creatures.
• Despite the visual resembling a slash, the secondary attack deals piercing damage.
• The blade of the Himminafl constantly sparkles with electricity; it also glows faintly blue at all times. It is very dim compared to most proper light sources, but can provide a small amount of light in the dark. The glow effect also makes players slightly easier to detect while sneaking, increasing the visibility of its holder by approximately 10%.

## Trivia

• The Himminafl translates to "Heaven's Might" in Old Norse.
• Prior to patch 0.217.4, the name of the Himminafl was spelled "Himmin afl".
